reason: Candidate 4 (collision pairs resolved by context, six more applications, holdout-3 folded into development). Scored once on holdout-4.json: 341 false conversions on the independent test, all in two authored negative families - the transliterated loanword `аутлук` (240 rows, every row) and the identifier-like `httpx` (96) plus `htop` after a slash (4) and one `grpc` row. The shipped candidate 3 converts the same `аутлук` and `httpx` rows and 773 rows in total on this file, including Russian collision words after Russian context (`уфе`, `вузе`, `муку`, `лук`); the release policy requires zero false conversions regardless, so the candidate is not promoted. Collision families on test: zero false conversions on all six unseen pairs, contextual recall between 50% and 100% per pair.
evidence_scope: author-created-synthetic-scenarios-not-real-world-quality; holdout-4.json is now disclosed and may not serve as a new independent test
